content.user_title: Map Influencer Audiences and Niche Communities
content.value_statement: Influencer teams need audience evidence before they select creators. Audience Mapper turns brand, product, or niche context into audience profiles, platform priorities, personas, and community entry guidance.
actual_capabilities: Infers audience or niche mode from a brand, product, category, community, or hashtag.
Creates demographic, psychographic, behavioral, platform, content, and influencer affinity profiles.
Builds named audience personas and selection criteria for creator discovery.
Maps community culture, language, norms, taboos, key voices, and content ecosystems.
Scores niche entry fit with a 25-point Brand Fit Score and phased entry strategy.
Can save a Markdown deliverable and promote durable facts after user confirmation.
limitations: It does not find, contract, or score individual creators for ACE.
It does not calculate ART, ROI, or CVI performance scores.
Live accuracy depends on provided data or available connectors.
Memory writes require explicit user confirmation and a compatible host.

use_cases.title: Plan Creator Discovery
use_cases.description: Convert a brand brief into audience profiles, priority platforms, and creator selection criteria.

use_cases.title: Evaluate a New Community
use_cases.description: Decode a niche before outreach, including norms, taboos, key voices, and brand fit.

use_cases.title: Diagnose Campaign Misfit
use_cases.description: Review a weak campaign through audience behavior, content preferences, and platform alignment.

prompt_templates.title: Basic Audience Map
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a broad target audience.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the target audience for [brand/product] in [market]. Use audience mode and include demographics, psychographics, platform priorities, personas, and creator criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Audience From Customer Data
prompt_templates.scenario: Use first-party data to reduce assumptions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Build an audience profile for influencer targeting from this customer data: [paste data]. Mark every inferred attribute with confidence and explain creator implications.

prompt_templates.title: Niche Community Dossier
prompt_templates.scenario: Research a named subculture or community.
prompt_templates.prompt: Research the [niche/community] for [brand]. Use niche mode and cover culture, language, taboos, key voices, content ecosystem, risks, and entry strategy.

prompt_templates.title: Advanced Market Entry Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare a detailed influencer entry strategy.
prompt_templates.prompt: Deep-dive [subculture] for [brand/category] in [geo]. Include Brand Fit Score, cultural red lines, phased rollout, creator tiers, metrics, and discovery handoff.

output_examples.input: Analyze the audience for a premium skincare brand targeting millennial women in the United States.
output: Mode selected: audience, because the request is a broad brand audience question.
Deliverable includes demographic and psychographic profiles, platform priorities, content preferences, one persona, and creator selection criteria.
Handoff recommends creator discovery using the must-have criteria and platform mix.

output_examples.input: Research the BookTok community for a publishing imprint before creator outreach.
output: Mode selected: niche, because the request names a specific community.
Deliverable includes culture decode, insider language, taboos, voice tiers, content themes, Brand Fit Score, and red lines.
Entry strategy starts with listening, then soft creator partnerships, then active engagement.

output_examples.input: Our last creator campaign underperformed. Map likely audience and platform mismatches.
output: Analysis compares target behavior, content preferences, influencer affinity, and platform usage.
Findings identify mismatched creator traits, weak trust factors, and unsupported platform assumptions.
Next steps translate the diagnosis into revised creator criteria.

best_practices: Provide first-party data, campaign goals, geography, price point, and any known audience segments.
Ask for confidence levels on inferred attributes and separate evidence from assumptions.
Use the handoff criteria before running creator discovery or fit scoring.
anti_patterns: Do not use it to choose specific creators without a separate discovery and scoring step.
Do not treat inferred demographics as facts when no customer data is available.
Do not enter a niche without reviewing language, norms, taboos, and red lines.

faq.question: What is Audience Mapper for?
faq.answer: It maps target audiences and niche communities before influencer discovery or creator scoring.

faq.question: What is the difference between audience mode and niche mode?
faq.answer: Audience mode profiles broad customers. Niche mode decodes a specific community, subculture, or hashtag.

faq.question: Can it find creators to hire?
faq.answer: No. It prepares criteria and handoff notes for a separate influencer discovery skill.

faq.question: Can it use real customer data?
faq.answer: Yes. Customer surveys, CRM exports, analytics, and social insights can improve confidence.

faq.question: Does it compute creator fit scores?
faq.answer: No. It does not compute ACE, ART, ROI, or CVI scores.

faq.question: Does it write files automatically?
faq.answer: It asks before saving results or promoting durable facts to memory.
